meta.name: containerization-assistant
meta.description: Generate Dockerfiles, Docker Compose configurations, and Kubernetes manifests for containerizing applications. Use when: (1) Creating Dockerfiles for Node.js, Python, Java, Go, or other applications, (2) Setting up multi-service environments with Docker Compose, (3) Generating Kubernetes deployments, services, and ingress configurations, (4) Optimizing container images for production, (5) Implementing containerization best practices. Provides both ready-to-use templates and custom-generated configurations based on project requirements.

copy.tagline: 为应用生成容器化配置和部署清单。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将应用容器化并部署到 Kubernetes。
